description:
Filter a list of maps by field predicates.

  Args:
  - `entries` / `rows` / `items` / `data` — list of maps
  - Single predicate: `field`, `op`, `value`
  - Or `filters` — list of `%{field, op, value}` (AND)

  Ops: `eq`, `neq`, `contains`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `in`, `exists`.
